neighbours.label: the token just before the name of a title or show: 'series'/'film' or an opening quote that introduces it
fire: She is remembered for her role in the television series Dallas, which ran for years.
My parents loved the old sitcom titled “Taxi,” about New York cab drivers.
He wrote music for the TV series Friends during its first season.
The director's breakthrough was the film titled “Jaws,” released in 1975.
Critics praised the animated series Arcane for its painterly style.
Back then everyone watched the drama series ER on Thursday nights.
Her favourite book is the novel titled “Rebecca,” by Daphne du Maurier.
He first appeared on the British series Doctor Who as a guest star.
